title: ServiceRevisionProposal
description: ENG-06 new contract. Source: backlog.md#eng-06 (商家工作清單、補資料、決策卡) and the UX 2.1 prototype's service-revision interaction (prototypes/merchant-assistant/ux-v2.1). This is the structured payload a merchant's own free-text explanation is parsed into; it becomes a Work's DecisionRequest.display_payload once complete (specs/domain/decision-request.schema.json). It is workbench-local, not a cross-ENG domain contract: capacity/duration bounds here are the demo resource policy from the prototype, not a platform-wide inventory rule (that is ENG-02 scope).

content.description: The merchant's own explanation, preserved verbatim (backlog ENG-06 acceptance: 模型解析出的內容可核對且不被固定範例覆蓋). A service MUST NOT substitute a canned example for this field.

capacity.description: Demo resource cap carried over from the UX 2.1 prototype (最多 8 席); not a platform-wide inventory rule. backlog ENG-06 acceptance: 容量等不合法值在前後端都被拒絕.

asset_ref.description: Opaque reference to a stored asset (e.g. an uploaded explanation card); never a raw file or objectURL.

asset_waived.description: True when the merchant explicitly chose to publish without this optional asset (UX 2.1 '先只做中文接待版').

rights_confirmed.description: Merchant's explicit confirmation of usage rights for asset_ref; meaningless and ignored when asset_ref is absent.

allOf.description: An asset can only be carried into a decision card once its usage rights are confirmed (UX 2.1 material() gating).
A proposal is only complete once it either carries a confirmed asset or the merchant explicitly waived it.
